problem: Latest GOTO recording has6 forward starts with actual yaw0.352..0.988rad/s. GOTO did not use the existing SEARCH yaw handoff conditioner.
changes: Extend only the turn/translation reference conditioner to GOTO:80mrad/s-per100ms angular acceleration,200mrad/s-per100ms angular braking.
Before forward restart, require fresh feedback, actual yaw<=150mrad/s for2 cycles and commanded yaw nearly zero; retain the linear startup ramp.
No instantaneous fore/aft wheel-speed or low-pitch-rate prerequisite is introduced. Preserve the existing SEARCH-only20deg tilt suppression scope.
check_notes: The first pure-rotation obstacle fixture encountered the existing starting-circle clearance exception in both old/new code. Corrected the fixture to translating toward a lethal footprint; both versions reject it with MOTION_HAZARD. No production collision rule was changed.
open_issue: Lookahead direction changes and sustained near-goal low-speed behavior are separate review items; not silently changed by this patch.
